9 DAYS / SUMMER ITINERARY

Follow the railway
into glaciers and wilderness.

Trains, glaciers, bears and a road trip.
Our travel experiences across four national parks in nine days.

Start with Day 1 ↗

Our transport connections and changes along the way

From Anchorage we took trains to the fjords and Denali, flew to Brooks Camp for bears, then drove to Copper Center. The first Katmai flight turned back for weather; a different operator got us there the next day, the journey's most memorable twist.

BOOK THE CONNECTIONS

Book transport and main activities before small stops.

Days 2–5: arranged through Alaska Railroad

The rail package connected Seward and Denali. Ask Alaska Railroad about seasonal packages and inclusions; use your confirmation for activities, hotels and transfers.

Suggested booking sequence

Confirm Katmai viewing and Denali lodging/Tundra Wilderness Tour availability first, then the four train legs and Seward noon sailing together. Arrange hotel transfers and the rental car afterward. Book the Tundra Tour in advance; 48 hours is when the departure time is announced.

DayTrain and routeDeparture → arrivalArrangement
Day 2 outboundCoastal Classic
Anchorage → Seward		06:45 → 11:20Book a same-day round trip and a cruise that connects with the train.
Day 2 returnCoastal Classic
Seward → Anchorage		18:00 → 22:15The cruise needs to return around 17:30, followed by a direct station transfer.
Day 3Denali Star

Day 5Denali Star
Denali → Anchorage		12:30 → 20:00Keep the morning to the visitor center and entrance area.

Check train and boat connections together

Ask Alaska Railroad about combined packages, or provide your train times to the cruise company when booking separately. Avoid a sailing that departs before you can connect.

GoldStar or Adventure Class

Choose by budget and check meal inclusions. Dining, meal times and seating depend on the ticket and arrangements. Do not squeeze a town lunch into the train-to-boat connection.

Book lodging together and confirm transfers

A railroad package with lodging includes transfers for its arranged hotels, and Denali hotels commonly run shuttles. Confirm early Anchorage pickup, Denali station service, park-entrance schedules, stops and reservation requirements when booking. Train-only tickets require separate lodging transport arrangements.

KEEP THE DAYS CONNECTED

Three connections that need breathing room.

Seward Visitor Center

The train arrives at 11:20 for a 12:00 sailing. We managed a rushed ten-minute visitor-center visit. Complete check-in and confirm boarding first; go only if time allows. Stay overnight for a thorough visit.

Denali afternoon

Tours run daily in season and require advance booking, with the actual time confirmed 48 hours ahead. An approximately 06:00 departure may allow dogs and river afterward. Later tours require removing activities, not simply pushing everything later.

Katmai replacement flight and return

Day 6's flight turned back. Another operator got us to the bears on Day 7; afterward we collected a car and drove to Copper Center. It was tight. An extra day avoids the evening drive.
